title: After switching Light Switch ON and exiting the GUI - it turns back OFF

judgment.rationale: The report says Light Switch is turned on and that schedule/theme actions occur, then the feature appears off after reopening the GUI, but it does not distinguish closing only the Settings window from exiting PowerToys or restarting the app. Current upstream Settings code initializes the toggle from GeneralSettingsConfig.Enabled.LightSwitch and writes that value back when changed; the module's runtime enabled state is separate from its theme/schedule actions. No discussion or attachment clarifies which state is resetting, so a focused reproduction and fresh report are needed before a fix judgment.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask which process/window is closed and whether the enabled checkbox itself is off versus only the schedule or theme state. Request one minimal enable-close-reopen sequence and a fresh /bugreport immediately after the reset; do not infer that changing the OS theme toggles the module enabled state.
evidence: The issue is open, on PowerToys 0.102.2933, and has no comments or attachment; its description combines turning the feature on, setting a schedule or using the theme shortcut, and reopening the GUI.
Current upstream LightSwitchViewModel initializes IsEnabled from GeneralSettingsConfig.Enabled.LightSwitch and updates the same property when toggled; it sends general settings through IPC.
Current upstream LightSwitch module exposes a separate runtime is_enabled state and starts/stops its service; theme toggles and schedule behavior are separate paths.
Related #42921 concerns the default theme starting in Light mode, not the enabled checkbox resetting. Merged PR #50459 adds CLI status/theme/schedule control, not this GUI persistence behavior.
No exact duplicate, candidate fix, canonical issue artifact, or fork issue/PR mirror was found.

fix_assessment.rationale: No code fix is currently justified because the report does not establish whether the module's enabled setting resets, whether only the PowerToys Settings window was closed, or whether a schedule/theme state is being confused with the enable toggle. The current code already persists the GeneralSettings enabled property through the settings message path; verify the exact state and lifecycle before proposing a change.

actions.label: Request a minimal Light Switch enable-state reproduction

comment.body: Could you clarify whether you close only the PowerToys Settings window or exit PowerToys itself, and whether the Light Switch enable checkbox is off after reopening (rather than only the schedule or current theme state)? Please test this minimal sequence: enable Light Switch, close only Settings while leaving PowerToys running, reopen Settings, and check the enable toggle. If it resets, add a comment containing `/bugreport` immediately after reproducing and say whether PowerToys was exited or restarted. This will separate the persisted module setting from the schedule/theme action.
